title: The Last Oath
premise: In the city of Vharrow, where magic was outlawed after the Godfall, Ulyana Kavanagh survives by selling harmless charms while hiding her guild oathmark beneath her sleeve. When prayers begin to be answered again and her guildmaster dies whispering a debt she never knew existed, Ulyana learns her own soul was collateral in a bargain struck generations ago with the court beneath the mountain. To reclaim it—and the last ember of dragon-fire that keeps the old gods from waking ravenous—she must gather the scattered survivors of her dying guild, betray the friend who hunts mages for the crown, and descend into the Undercourt itself. In the end, Ulyana pays the debt not with her soul but with her name and inheritance, becoming the guild's final living oath: unseen, unnamed, and free.
about_author: Tamsin Montrose is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about debts, oaths, and the people history forgets to record.

chapters.title: Charms for the Godless
chapters.summary: Ulyana sells a luck-knot to a grieving widow in Vharrow's night market, hiding her oathmark when a crown inspector passes. POV Ulyana. Establishes her invisibility as survival; ends with the widow's prayer being audibly answered.

chapters.title: The Guild of Small Mercies
chapters.summary: Ulyana visits the crumbling guildhall where three aged members keep a fire that never goes out. Her guildmaster, Sorrel, refuses to explain why the flame matters. POV Ulyana. Emotional beat: tenderness tangled with secrecy.

chapters.title: What the Widow Prayed For
chapters.summary: The widow's dead son walks home whole—and hollow-eyed. Ulyana realizes answered prayers are taking something in return. POV Ulyana. Fear sharpens into resolve to investigate.

chapters.title: Sorrel's Last Confession
chapters.summary: Dying, Sorrel tells Ulyana the guild sold a soul to the court beneath the mountain to end the Godfall—and that the soul was Ulyana's, pledged at her birth. POV Sorrel then Ulyana. Grief and betrayal collide.

chapters.title: The Ember Ledger
chapters.summary: Ulyana finds the guild's debt-book: five souls sold, four reclaimed, hers outstanding, due when the last dragon-fire gutters out. POV Ulyana. She resolves to steal it back rather than wait.

chapters.title: A Hunter Named Wren
chapters.summary: Crown mage-hunter Wren Calloway, Ulyana's childhood friend, arrives investigating the answered prayers. Their reunion is warm and wary. POV Wren. Beat: loyalty pulling against duty.

chapters.title: Ash on the Doorstep
chapters.summary: A guild member is found burned from the inside—the mountain court collecting early. Ulyana flees the guildhall as inspectors seal it. POV Ulyana. Beat: terror and flight.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Toll
chapters.summary: Ulyana buys passage out of Vharrow from smuggler Dagny Holt, paying with a charm that shouldn't work—but does. POV Dagny. Beat: reluctant alliance formed over mutual debts.

chapters.title: Road of Quiet Gods
chapters.summary: On the road, shrines long cold are warming. Ulyana tests her own magic for the first time in years and it answers too eagerly. POV Ulyana. Beat: power as temptation.

chapters.title: The Second Survivor
chapters.summary: Ulyana finds Ilse, a guild archivist living disguised as a nun, who reveals the debt's original terms: the soul must be returned willingly or the fire dies. POV Ilse. Beat: hope with a hook in it.

chapters.title: Wren Closes In
chapters.summary: Wren traces the answered prayers to the guild and interrogates Dagny, who gives nothing away but burns her own luck doing so. POV Wren. Beat: loyalty tested by evidence.

chapters.title: The Mountain's Shadow
chapters.summary: The party reaches Greyhollow beneath the mountain, where the Undercourt's influence makes bargains binding and lies physically painful. POV Ulyana. Beat: entering enemy country.

chapters.title: Terms of Trade
chapters.summary: An Undercourt herald offers Ulyana a shortcut: surrender another soul in place of hers. She refuses, learning the court wants her specifically. POV Ulyana. Beat: integrity under pressure.

chapters.title: Ilse's Bargain
chapters.summary: Ilse secretly negotiates her own deal to spare Ulyana, revealing the archivist has been the court's informant for decades. POV Ilse. Beat: betrayal from within the found family.

chapters.title: The Fire That Remembers
chapters.summary: Guided by a half-mad priest, Ulyana touches the last dragon-fire and sees visions of the Godfall: the gods didn't die, they were starved by the guild's own bargain. POV Ulyana. Beat: inherited guilt.

chapters.title: Wren's Warrant
chapters.summary: Wren arrests Dagny and sends word to Vharrow, torn between the law she serves and the friend she can't stop protecting. POV Wren. Beat: the cost of duty.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: Ulyana, Dagny freed by Ilse's sacrifice of her archives, begins the descent into the Undercourt through mines full of sold souls still dreaming. POV Ulyana. Beat: courage hardening.

chapters.title: The Soul Market
chapters.summary: In the market of traded selves, Ulyana finds her soul kept in a lantern, wearing her face and begging to be left alone. POV Ulyana. Beat: confronting the self she abandoned.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath
chapters.summary: Ulyana is granted audience with the Undercourt's regent, who claims the guild's debt bought the city's peace—and that canceling it wakes what sleeps above. POV Regent. Beat: the villain's terrible logic.

chapters.title: Counteroffer
chapters.summary: Ulyana proposes a new contract: her service instead of her soul. The regent accepts—with a clause she doesn't hear fully. POV Ulyana. Beat: hope built on a flaw.

chapters.title: What Wren Found Below
chapters.summary: Wren, disobeying orders, follows Ulyana down and witnesses the soul market firsthand, shattering her faith in the crown's version of the Godfall. POV Wren. Beat: conversion through horror.

chapters.title: Reunion in the Dark
chapters.summary: Wren and Ulyana meet again below; old friendship reignites even as Wren admits she arrested Dagny. Forgiveness is offered but not yet earned. POV alternating. Beat: reconciliation begun.

chapters.title: The Clause
chapters.summary: Dagny deciphers the contract: Ulyana's service means serving until the fire dies—which the regent intends to hasten. POV Dagny. Beat: trap revealed.

chapters.title: Ilse's Price
chapters.summary: Ilse returns, having traded her memories of the guild for the key to the fire-vault, no longer knowing who Ulyana is. POV Ilse. Beat: sacrifice without recognition.

chapters.title: Storm Above Greyhollow
chapters.summary: The dragon-fire gutters; across the land, answered prayers turn predatory as starving god-fragments wake. The surface world begins to break. POV multiple brief vignettes. Beat: stakes made global.

chapters.title: Riot of the Faithful
chapters.summary: Vharrow erupts as citizens demand miracles; the crown's anti-magic law collapses into mob violence. Wren's superiors order her to kill Ulyana on sight. POV Wren. Beat: world inverted.

chapters.title: The Vault of Embers
chapters.summary: Using Ilse's key, the party reaches the vault where the last dragon-fire and Ulyana's soul-lantern are kept together—the court always intended them as one payment. POV Ulyana. Beat: the trap closes.

chapters.title: The Regent Unmasked
chapters.summary: The regent reveals herself as the first guildmaster, who founded the debt to save the city and has been prolonging her service ever since. POV Regent. Beat: mirror of Ulyana's possible future.

chapters.title: Fight for the Lantern
chapters.summary: Battle in the vault: Dagny holds the door, Ilse remembers one thing—Ulyana's name—and Wren turns her hunter's craft against the court. POV rotating. Beat: loyalty proven in action.

chapters.title: The Choice of Souls
chapters.summary: Ulyana can take back her soul or carry the ember—but the vessel only holds one. She chooses the fire, leaving her self behind. POV Ulyana. Beat: sacrifice at the heart of the theme.

chapters.title: Ascent
chapters.summary: Bearing the ember, Ulyana climbs as the Undercourt collapses around them; Dagny is gravely wounded shielding the group. POV Dagny. Beat: cost counted in blood.

chapters.title: The Regent's Last Oath
chapters.summary: The dying regent releases Ulyana from the flawed clause, passing her the true oath: the guild exists to give magic away, not hoard it. POV Regent. Beat: inheritance redeemed.

chapters.title: Climax: The Guttering
chapters.summary: At the mountaintop shrine, the starving god-fragments converge. Ulyana feeds them the ember—not extinguishing it but sharing it, ending scarcity itself. POV Ulyana. Beat: climax through generosity, not violence.

chapters.title: Aftermath of Light
chapters.summary: Magic returns lawfully wild; prayers are answered by small gods who ask small things. Wren must decide whether to report Ulyana alive. POV Wren. Beat: mercy over law.

chapters.title: Dagny's Debt Paid
chapters.summary: Dagny recovers and burns her smuggling ledger, choosing to ferry pilgrims instead of contraband. POV Dagny. Beat: redemption in ordinary work.

chapters.title: Ilse Remembers Everything
chapters.summary: With the court broken, Ilse's memories return—including every betrayal she committed. She asks Ulyana for judgment; Ulyana offers apprenticeship instead. POV Ilse. Beat: forgiveness as structure.

chapters.title: The Rebuilding of the Guild
chapters.summary: The guildhall reopens with four members and open doors, teaching magic freely under the new covenant. Ulyana takes Sorrel's chair. POV Ulyana. Beat: legacy renewed.

chapters.title: The Nameless Chair
chapters.summary: To void the original contract forever, Ulyana surrenders her family name and inheritance to the guild's ledger, becoming simply 'the youngest member.' POV Ulyana. Beat: identity released, not lost.

chapters.title: Wren's Report
chapters.summary: Wren files a report declaring Ulyana Kavanagh dead in the Undercourt collapse, then visits the guildhall as a private citizen. POV Wren. Beat: loyalty finally aligned with truth.

chapters.title: Resolution: A Charm for the Widow
chapters.summary: One year later, Ulyana—nameless, marked, free—sells a simple charm to a young widow and teaches her to pray safely. The fire in the guildhall burns steady. POV Ulyana. Beat: full-circle peace.
